data.narrative:
Cortical Labs is a Series A-stage AI & Software company that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir), with top private peers including Reflection AI, Scale AI, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs at valuations ranging from $3.2B to $29.0B.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $11M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $22M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $15.3B, with a range spanning $3.2B (Black Forest Labs, Series B) to $29.0B (Scale AI, Series B). The wide dispersion reflects material differences in development stage, capital efficiency, and market positioning within the frontier AI sector.

Triangulating these methods produces a low estimate of $19M, a median of $7.7B, and a high estimate of $17.6B. The significant spread between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects inherent uncertainty in applying public-market and late-stage private comparables to an early-stage frontier-tech company. Stage and capital intensity appear to be primary drivers of variance. The peer-median approach likely overstates Cortical Labs' current valuation, suggesting the true range sits materially below the $15.3B median, conditional on near-term execution and funding trajectory.
